**Severity:** error · **Area:** Static calls (i18n) (`RV4xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
Unknown param "{name}" for "{key}"
```

```text
Missing param "{name}" for "{key}"
```

```text
Tag <{name}> in "{key}" needs a param: {export}("{key}", { {name}: (c) => <…>{c}</…> })
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Pass exactly the params the message declares: `t("greet", { name, age })`; tags need a (c) => `<tag>{c}</tag>` param.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("greet", { name: 1 });
```

```tsx prefer
import { t } from "@rivetjs/i18n";
export const x = t("greet", { name: 1, age: 2 });
```

## When it is reported

Build only.
